title: Bare Theme
description: Defines the semantic design tokens for a Bare site.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the Bare Theme schema used by this theme.

base.description: The primary colour of the site.

surface.description: The colour used for surfaces such as cards and panels.

accent.description: The primary accent colour used for interactive and prominent elements.

text.description: The primary colour used for text.

muted.description: The colour used for secondary or less prominent content.

border.description: The colour used for borders and separators.

heading.description: The primary font used for headings.

body.description: The primary font used for body text.

spacing.description: The overall spacing density of the site.

shape.description: The overall shape language of the site.
